pli-tv-bi-vb-np12:2.2.11: The nuns’ offenses entailing relinquishment 13–30 are respectively identical to the monks’ relinquishment  ???    at [pli-tv-bu-vb-ss10:1.3.16.1](), 11 at [pli-tv-bu-vb-ss11:1.19.1](), 12 at [pli-tv-bu-vb-ss12:1.26.1](), and 13 at [pli-tv-bu-vb-ss13:1.8.10.1](), with appropriate gender changes.
pli-tv-bi-vb-np12:2.2.14: Before this summary line, the Pali reads _(Dutiya) Pattavagga_, “the (second) subchapter on almsbowls”, to indicate the last subchapter of _nissaggiya pācittiya_ rules for the nuns, and then _Pariṇatasikkhāpada_, “the training rule on diverting an offering intended for the Sangha”, to indicate the last rule in the chapter of _nissaggiya pācittiya_ rules. These indications are redundant in the present translation, since I have pointed to all the missing rules, including direct references to their counterparts in the chapter on _nissaggiya pācittiya_ rules for the monks.
